title: Crossplane sync: routing + quotas + auth (weekly)
content:
Meeting: Crossplane sync (routing / quotas / auth) - weekly
Date: 2026-09-14
Time: 10:00-10:45 PT
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha, Liam, Mateo, Joanna, Priya, Evan (notes)
Location: #platform-controlplane / Zoom
Purpose: quick status across control plane subsystems, identify cross-cutting blockers, agree owners for next week

Agenda:
- Quick status (5m each): Control plane core, Routing/allocator, Auth/Identity, Quotas & billing
- Recent incidents & mitigations
- Open design decisions (routing policies, quota eviction semantics)
- Action items & owners
- Parking lot: rollout timing for v2 routing allocator

----
TL;DR summary:
- Control plane: core upgrade to stateful controller went well in canary; one regression (cache TTL) identified and patched. Canary -> prod rollout scheduled 9/16 with phased traffic shift.
- Routing: allocator prototype shows 18% tail-latency improvement in synthetic tests; need to validate under mixed seq-length real traffic. Two blocker PRs on allocator placement and metrics tagging.
- Auth: rolling KMS rotation ran on staging; final step depends on infra team's firewall rule for new HSM endpoints.
- Quotas: short-term hotfix for per-customer burst was shipped (PLT-1284) but observed quota accounting drift for nested requests; root cause suspected in async aggregation window (15s vs 60s).

Notes / Deep dive

1) Control plane core
- Status: Canary cluster (canary-3) rolled with controller v1.8.3-alpha. Observed: cache TTL was truncated for ephemeral keys when TTL > 1h. Patch merged (controlplane#412) to use explicit expiry semantics; backported to stable-1.7 branch.
- Risk: migration of persisted leases during staged rollout may extend leader election pauses by ~200-300ms. We will keep leader election window at 1s for prod rollout. Team asked for 24h monitoring window after rollout.
- Follow-ups: add metric cp.lease_migration.duration and alert if > 500ms (OWNER: Joanna, ticket PLT-1290).

2) Routing & allocator
- Status: allocator v0.6 prototype (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/allocator PR#66). Synthetic load tests (varied seq lengths, 8k tokens per second) show 18% P95 improvement, P99 improved marginally.
- Tests using real traffic replay needed. Mateo to run replay with last week's traffic slice (2026-09-07) across staging cluster. Need to ensure KV cache cookie preserved in replay.
- Blockers:
  - Metrics tagging PR delayed: without per-tenant tags we can't measure cross-tenant fairness (PR#71, OWNER: Liam).
  - Placement logic edgecases for small batches causing cold-start GPU allocations; we need an eviction heuristic patch.
- Decision checkpoint: allocate effort to finish metrics tagging this sprint; if metrics tagging not done, hold on wide rollout.

3) Auth / Identity
- Status: KMS/HSM rotation performed in staging. Rotation tooling exercised, logs look good. Production rotation pending firewall rule update by infra (ticket INF-442).
- Short-term mitigation: we will keep previous KMS key as fallback for 48h post-rotation. Need runbook entry with exact rollback steps (OWNER: Priya, DUE: 2026-09-16).
- Open question: should token introspection be cached at gateway for 500ms to reduce QPS on introspection service? Consensus: experiment for 200ms cache TTL; Joanna to prototype.

4) Quotas & billing
- Status: rolled out hotfix PLT-1284 to prevent burst allowance exceeding committed burst for a tiny % of requests. Fix excluded nested async jobs; observed accounting drift during high concurrency.
- Root cause hypothesis: aggregation window mismatch between request-side counters (15s) and quota-aggregator (60s). Proposed fixes:
  - Short term: align aggregator window to 15s and add smoothing to reduce oscillation (low risk, OWNER: Liam, DUE: 2026-09-18)
  - Long term: instrument per-request causal IDs and attribution path to ensure nested quotas attribute to parent request correctly (OWNER: Evan, epic PLT-1302)
- Customer impact: one enterprise customer (acct: acme-corp) reported temporary overrun billing alerts on 9/12 (INC-2026-09-12-01). CS notified and credit issued pending root cause confirmation.

Incident recap (INC-2026-09-12-01)
- Summary: on 9/12 a small percentage (~0.4%) of nested inference requests bypassed burst controls leading to billing spikes and quota-exhausted errors for downstream tenants.
- Timeline: spike at 02:14 UTC; mitigated by rate-limiter fallback at 02:27 UTC. Hotfix deployed 02:55 UTC.
- Next steps: postmortem draft (Evan) due 9/17; include timeline, root cause (aggregation window mismatch), customer communication notes.

Decisions made
- Hold wide rollout of allocator v0.6 until metrics tagging is merged (blocker).
- Short-term quota aggregator window will be changed to 15s to align with counters; monitor for oscillation; revert path documented.
- KMS rotation: proceed in prod only after INF-442 firewall rule is applied; keep previous key as fallback for 48h after rotation.

Action items (owner / due)
- Joanna: add metric cp.lease_migration.duration + alert (PLT-1290) / 2026-09-16
- Mateo: run traffic replay for allocator v0.6 against staging slice (9/7) and share results / 2026-09-17
- Liam: finish metrics tagging PR for allocator and unblock measurements (PR#71) / 2026-09-16
- Priya: write KMS rotation runbook with rollback steps; coordinate with infra (INF-442) / 2026-09-16
- Evan: draft incident postmortem INC-2026-09-12-01, include CS template / 2026-09-17
- Aisha: schedule canary -> prod rollout for control plane v1.8.3 on 2026-09-16; coord with SRE and paging rotation / 2026-09-15
- Liam + Evan: short-term quota window alignment change and smoke test plan / 2026-09-18

Blockers & help requested
- Infra: need firewall rule INF-442 to allow HSM endpoints for KMS rotation (Priya is blocked until this is applied).
- Observability: tagging gap for allocator metrics; request observability team to expedite metrics pipeline change if PR stalls.
- CS: provide list of impacted accounts for incident billing credits (Evan to follow up with CS)

Risks and mitigations
- Risk: allocator rollout without per-tenant telemetry could cause unfair scheduling; mitigation: keep rollout scoped to non-critical customers and canary nodes only.
- Risk: quota window change could increase oscillation; mitigation: add smoothing and enable canary sampling for 1% of traffic first.

Parking lot / future topics
- Discuss flow control for nested async jobs in next week's meeting (need design doc).
- Revisit token introspection caching TTL after Joanna's prototype.
- Plan for allocator v1.0 feature freeze and performance SLA targets (TBD)

Notes to self / scribbles
- Confirm time for prod canary 9/16: aim 02:00 UTC low-traffic window
- Add link to PLT-1284 changelog in release notes
- Follow up with CS about customer-facing postmortem language (no apology sentences that imply SLA breach)

Next sync
- Date: 2026-09-21 (weekly)
- Quick sync channel: #platform-controlplane-ops

Document history
- Created by: Aisha Patel 2026-09-14
- Edited (small clarifications): 2026-09-15 (Joanna added metric name)
